Исправил игру:

- **Управление:** WASD и стрелки двигают персонажа; мышь — прицеливание. На телефоне джойстик отвечает за движение, а свайп по экрану — за обзор.
- **Т-34-85:** заменил условную машинку на более детализированный танк — с гусеницами, катками, башней, пушкой, люками и отметками.
- **Танк можно водить:** подойдите к нему и нажмите **E**; **W/S** — ехать, **A/D** — поворачивать, **E** — выйти.

Синтаксис `three-game.js` проверен. Предположил, что просьба «не могу ходить» относится к управлению персонажем, а «т-34-85» — к танку у старта.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing playable game: add usable mobile controls, more believable bots and an open-world battlefield, and detailed weapon models with reload animation.
- Continue refining the T-34-85 interaction and make faction selection playable for Germany.

## Requirements
- Add an on-screen joystick for walking and a nearby vehicle-entry control when close to transport.
- Make the game’s look more cartoonish and fun.
- Bots should use varied routes and tactics, notice and engage each other, and enter/use transport rather than marching in straight lines.
- Add proper weapon models instead of a stick, plus a reload animation.
- Expand the map into a compact open world; avoid the long, empty-plate feeling.
- User has not yet tested the updated game as Germany.

## Decisions
- The previous response interpreted the initial walking issue as broken movement controls and added keyboard, touch joystick movement, and touch-swipe look.
- A detailed T-34-85 model and basic drivable interaction were added in `three-game.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- `three-game.js`: added T-34-85 geometry and basic driving interaction; movement accepts WASD and arrow keys.
- `three-game.js`: added touch-swipe camera look; `node --check three-game.js` passed.

### Active
- Implement mobile vehicle-entry control that appears near the vehicle.
- Improve visual style, bots’ movement/target selection and ally/enemy interactions, map layout, weapons, and reload animation.
- Verify Germany faction behavior and tank/controls in-game.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Продолжить улучшение игры: сделать удобные мобильные джойстики движения и прицеливания/поворота, отдельную стрельбу и заметно более объёмную, реалистичную модель оружия.

## Requirements
- Мобильное управление должно включать джойстик ходьбы, джойстик прицеливания и отдельную кнопку стрельбы.
- Заменить текущую простую геометрическую модель оружия на детальную объёмную модель, подходящую к сеттингу и сопоставимую по качеству с Т-34-85.
- Сохранить и продолжать существующие улучшения игры и управления.

## Decisions
- Движение и прицеливание разделены на два сенсорных джойстика; стрельба вынесена в отдельную кнопку.

## Work State
### Completed
- Добавлены экранные кнопки входа/выхода из танка, перезарядки и стрельбы; кнопка танка показывается рядом с машиной.
- Добавлена анимация перезарядки оружия.
- Реализован начальный процедурный силуэт оружия и обновлена логика ботов.
- Проверены `node --check three-game.js` и `git diff --check` до последних незавершённых изменений.

### Active
- В `index.html` начата переработка мобильного HUD под отдельные джойстики движения и прицеливания; разметка и CSS есть, но обработчики джойстика прицеливания и интеграция в поворот камеры ещё не добавлены.
- Улучшить текущую упрощённую модель оружия в `makeWeapon()` до выраженной детальной объёмной модели.
- Проверить новые изменения синтаксисом и в браузере.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Дописать обработчик `#aimStick` в `three-game.js`, чтобы джойстик поворачивал камеру и сбрасывался при отпускании.
2. Убедиться, что `#stick` остаётся отдельным джойстиком движения и не конфликтует с сенсорным управлением камеры на canvas.
3. Существенно детализировать `makeWeapon()` в `three-game.js` — приклад, ствольная коробка, ствол/кожух, прицел, рукоятки и характерный магазин; учесть фракцию.
4. Проверить мобильную раскладку, `node --check three-game.js`, `git diff --check` и запуск в браузере.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Three.js, управление, `makeWeapon()`, стрельба, перезарядка и игровая логика.
- `index.html`: мобильный HUD, джойстики и кнопки управления.

## Important Context
- Пользователь уточнил: «добавь джостик хотьбы стрельбы и прицела» и просит «оружие поменяй на объёмное реалестично очень подходящее».
- В текущем изменённом `index.html` джойстики имеют элементы `#stick` и `#aimStick`; прежний код `three-game.js` обрабатывает только `#stick`.
- Все изменения пока не закоммичены; браузерная проверка не выполнялась.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Продолжить улучшение игры: удобное мобильное управление и детализированная объёмная модель оружия, соответствующая качеству модели Т-34-85.

## Requirements
- На мобильных устройствах нужны отдельные джойстики движения и прицеливания, а также отдельная кнопка стрельбы.
- Заменить простую модель оружия на более реалистичную; внешний вид должен соответствовать выбранной фракции.
- Сохранить существующие улучшения игры и управления.

## Decisions
- Движение и прицеливание управляются отдельными сенсорными джойстиками; стрельба вынесена в отдельную кнопку.
- Для СССР реализована модель PPSh-41 с барабанным магазином, для Германии — MP 40 с коробчатым магазином и складным прикладом.

## Work State
### Completed
- Добавлены экранные джойстики MOVE и AIM, отдельные кнопки FIRE и RELOAD, а также существующие кнопки взаимодействия с танком.
- Реализован обработчик `#aimStick`: поворачивает камеру, ограничивает вертикальный угол и сбрасывает положение джойстика при отпускании.
- Кнопка FIRE стреляет при удержании с интервалом; движение и сенсорный ввод камеры разделены.
- `makeWeapon()` заменена детализированными фракционными моделями PPSh-41 и MP 40.
- `node --check three-game.js` и `git diff --check` прошли без ошибок после изменений.

### Active
- Проверить игру в браузере, особенно мобильное расположение джойстиков и взаимодействие одновременных сенсорных вводов.
- При проверке подтвердить, что детализация оружия хорошо читается в игровом ракурсе.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Запустить игру и проверить мобильные джойстики, удержание FIRE, RELOAD и отображение моделей обеих фракций.
2. Исправить обнаруженные проблемы интерфейса или поведения; затем повторно выполнить `node --check three-game.js` и `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: разметка и стили мобильного HUD.
- `three-game.js`: обработчики джойстиков, стрельба и `makeWeapon()`.

## Important Context
- Изменения в `index.html` и `three-game.js` не закоммичены.
- Браузерная проверка ещё не выполнялась.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the game with separate mobile movement and aiming controls plus a dedicated fire button.
- Replace the basic weapon model with detailed faction-specific 3D weapons while preserving gameplay improvements.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must support separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Weapon appearance should match the selected faction.

## Decisions
- Use a PPSh-41 with drum magazine for the USSR and an MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock for Germany.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile stick handlers, aiming limits, sustained fire while FIRE is held, and RELOAD handling.
- Added detailed faction-specific PPSh-41 and MP 40 meshes in `makeWeapon()`.
- Fixed mobile controls not appearing: inserted whitespace before the `@media(max-width:720px)` rule in `index.html`.
- Verified a 390×844 mobile viewport shows MOVE, AIM, FIRE, RELOAD, and jump controls; `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the CSS fix.

### Active
- Validate mobile simultaneous touch input, firing/reloading, and actual weapon appearance for both factions. Automated browser testing showed the USSR label; the attempted Germany switch still showed PPSh-41, so Germany is not yet verified.
- Rerun syntax and diff checks after the latest CSS change.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser-checking the gameplay and weapon meshes for both factions; resolve why the attempted faction switch still displayed PPSh-41.
2. Validate mobile joystick/fire/reload interactions and control placement.
3. Rerun `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and CSS, including the mobile media query fix.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input handlers, firing/reload behavior, faction selection, and `makeWeapon()`.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Headless mobile testing reported `WrongDocumentError: The root document of this element is not valid for pointer lock.` during simulated interaction; assess whether this is only a headless test artifact.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the game with separate mobile movement and aiming controls plus a dedicated fire button.
- Replace the basic weapon model with detailed faction-specific 3D weapons.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must support separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Weapon appearance should match the selected faction.

## Decisions
- Use a PPSh-41 with drum magazine for the USSR and an MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock for Germany.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile stick handlers, aiming limits, sustained fire while FIRE is held, and RELOAD handling.
- Added detailed faction-specific PPSh-41 and MP 40 meshes in `makeWeapon()`.
- Fixed the mobile media query in `index.html`; browser testing at 390×844 confirms MOVE, AIM, FIRE, RELOAD, jump, and vehicle controls display with visible bounds.

### Active
- Investigate why a Germany selection still reports PPSh-41 after deployment; the test confirmed the Germany option is selected, but HUD weapon text remains PPSh-41.
- Validate simultaneous mobile touch input and firing/reloading; current browser run did not simulate these interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Diagnose the Germany faction/weapon mismatch and verify the MP 40 appears after deployment.
2. Test simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE/RELOAD touch interactions and control placement.
3. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and CSS, including the corrected media query.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input handlers, faction selection, weapon construction, and deployment.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Headless browser testing reports `WrongDocumentError: The root document of this element is not valid for pointer lock.` during deployment; likely test-environment related, but assess if needed.
- The latest browser run confirmed controls display at 390×844 but still reported PPSh-41 for Germany.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the game with separate mobile movement and aiming controls plus a dedicated fire button.
- Add detailed faction-specific 3D weapons and ensure deployment uses the selected faction’s weapon.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must support separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Weapon appearance should match the selected faction.

## Decisions
- Use a PPSh-41 with drum magazine for the USSR and an MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock for Germany.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile stick handlers, aiming limits, sustained fire while FIRE is held, and RELOAD handling.
- Added detailed faction-specific PPSh-41 and MP 40 meshes in `makeWeapon()`.
- Fixed the mobile media query in `index.html`; browser testing at 390×844 confirmed mobile controls display with visible bounds.

### Active
- Diagnose why selecting Germany still appears to leave the HUD weapon as PPSh-41; a latest test script was changed to select Germany from a clean flow, but its output did not establish the result.
- Validate simultaneous mobile touch input and firing/reloading; current browser run did not test these interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the updated `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs` and verify the selected faction and weapon after deployment; inspect faction state and `makeWeapon()` deployment logic if mismatch persists.
2. Test simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE/RELOAD touch interactions and control placement.
3. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and CSS, including the corrected media query.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input handlers, faction selection, weapon construction, and deployment.
- `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs`: Browser test script updated to exercise clean Germany selection and deployment.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Headless browser testing reports `WrongDocumentError: The root document of this element is not valid for pointer lock.` during deployment; likely test-environment related, but assess if needed.
- The latest browser run’s output was truncated and did not verify whether Germany deploys with the MP 40.

## Objective
- Make the game playable on phones with clear movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and make allied bots use the tank instead of clustering or wandering aimlessly.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must work together, including separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Bots should spread out, face where they move, engage opponents, and use transport.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile movement and aiming controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD handling, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Browser-tested the existing mobile controls at 390×844: Germany deploys with MP 40; simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE works; RELOAD restores ammo to 35.

### Active
- Refactoring bot movement and adding an allied tank-transport sequence; current changes are incomplete and need repair before testing.

### Blocked
- `botStep` was partially modified: its target-selection code was removed, but the remaining code still expects `s.target`; `updateTransport(dt)` has been defined but is not yet called from the update loop. Bot behavior is therefore unfinished and may be broken.

3. Run `node --check three-game.js`, `git diff --check`, and test the mobile controls and bot behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and styles.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile controls, weapons, world setup, vehicle interaction, and in-progress bot/transport changes.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- The earlier mobile interaction test used simulated touch events, not a physical device.
- Recent bot code edits are not yet syntax-checked or browser-tested.

## Objective
- Make the game playable on phones with clear movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and have allied bots use the tank rather than clustering or wandering aimlessly.

## Requirements
- Mobile MOVE and AIM joysticks must work simultaneously with FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Bots should spread out, face where they move, engage opponents, and use transport.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile movement/aim controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Browser-tested mobile controls at 390×844: Germany deploys with MP 40; simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE works; RELOAD restores ammo to 35.
- Repaired bot target selection and added lane-based positioning, facing, and an allied tank boarding/transport sequence.
- Added `updateTransport(dt)` to the update loop.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest lane-spacing edit.

### Active
- Validate bot movement and tank transport state transitions, plus player vehicle interaction.
- Re-run syntax/diff checks after the latest edit and browser-test mobile controls and bot behavior.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` after the latest bot lane-spacing change.
2. Browser-test bot spacing, target engagement, allied boarding/unloading, and player entering/driving/exiting the tank.
3. Re-test mobile controls together after the bot and transport changes.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile controls, weapons, vehicle interaction, and in-progress bot/transport behavior.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and styles.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- The mobile interaction test used simulated touch events, not a physical device.
- The latest edit assigned bots `homeX`/`homeZ` lane coordinates, but `botStep` still appears to use `s.lane` directly for idle destinations; verify or reconcile this before testing.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Make the game playable on phones with clear movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and have allied bots use the tank rather than clustering or wandering aimlessly.

## Requirements
- Mobile MOVE and AIM joysticks must work simultaneously with FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Bots should spread out, face where they move, engage opponents, and use transport.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile movement/aim controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Added bot target selection, lane-based spacing, facing, and allied tank boarding/transport behavior.
- Raised the HUD stacking order in `index.html` so mobile controls appear above the canvas.
- Browser-checked at 390×844: Germany deploys with MP 40; touch FIRE reduces ammo from 35 to 34.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest transport and layout edits.

### Active
- Validate bot movement and tank transport state transitions, plus player entering/driving/exiting the tank.
- Re-test mobile MOVE/AIM/FIRE/RELOAD together; the latest browser test left ammo at 34 after a simulated reload press.

### Blocked
- Browser testing via `playwright-cli` failed because its expected Chromium executable was missing. A direct Playwright test using `/usr/bin/chromium` worked, but its simulated reload press did not restore ammo.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` after the latest edits.
2. Investigate why the browser test’s simulated RELOAD press did not restore ammo; re-test with a real button click or touch event.
3. Browser-test mobile joysticks simultaneously with FIRE/RELOAD and verify player tank entry, driving, and exit.
4. Verify bots spread out, engage opponents, and allies board, ride, and unload from the tank.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile controls, weapons, vehicle interaction, and bot/transport behavior.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and styles.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` remain uncommitted.
- The mobile interaction checks used emulated touch and a 390×844 browser viewport, not a physical device.
- Bots now have `homeX`/`homeZ` lane destinations, target selection uses a think timer, and `updateTransport(dt)` runs in the update loop.

## Objective
- Make the game playable on phones with clear movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and have allied bots spread out, engage opponents, and use transport.

## Requirements
- Mobile MOVE and AIM joysticks must work simultaneously with FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Bots should spread out, face where they move, engage opponents, board the tank, ride, and unload.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile movement/aim controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Added bot targeting, lane-based spacing, facing, and allied tank boarding/transport behavior.
- Fixed guarded pointer capture in `three-game.js` to prevent `InvalidStateError`; raised HUD stacking order in `index.html`.
- Browser-tested simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE; verified movement, aim, and ammo responded together.
- Browser-tested reload completion, plus player tank entry, driving, and exit.
- Added a transport condition so the tank waits rather than driving off while the player is near it.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the latest transport edit.

### Active
- Validate the transport wait fix, then confirm bots complete the ride, unload at the destination, and re-engage.
- Re-run syntax and diff checks and inspect the final diff.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Browser-test that the tank waits while the player is nearby, then resumes after the player moves away.
2. Confirm allied bots unload at the destination and continue engaging; inspect whether their spacing and engagement remain satisfactory.
3. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`; inspect `git diff`.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile controls, weapons, vehicle interaction, bot AI, and transport behavior.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup, controls, styles, and stacking order.

## Important Context
- `index.html` and `three-game.js` remain uncommitted.
- Transport tests before the latest fix showed allies board, but the vehicle stays at its loading point while the player remains nearby; destination unloading was not yet verified.
- Browser checks use emulated touch at 390×844, not a physical device.
- `playwright-cli` cannot launch because its expected Chromium executable is missing; direct Playwright using `/usr/bin/chromium` works.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Make the game reliably playable on phones with clear touch movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and allied tank transport behavior.

## Requirements
- Phone movement should use an on-screen joystick or holdable directional controls; movement continues while held.
- Phone aiming, sustained firing, reloading, and vehicle interaction should work through touch.
- Bots should spread out, engage opponents, board the tank, ride, unload, and re-engage.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.
- The allied tank waits while the player is within 12 units, then proceeds after the player moves away.
- Touch devices should get touch-specific controls and instructions; WASD guidance remains for desktop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile MOVE/AIM controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Added bot targeting, spacing, facing, and allied tank boarding/transport behavior.
- Fixed guarded pointer capture and raised HUD stacking order.
- Added touch-device detection, ensured controls display on coarse-pointer/touch devices, adjusted mobile HUD layout, added Russian control labels, and avoided requesting pointer lock on touch devices.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Verify that the updated joystick is visible and moves the character while held on a mobile-sized touch viewport; recheck touch aiming, firing, and reload.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test the latest mobile control changes in a touch-emulated browser, including movement, aiming, sustained fire, reload, and vehicle interaction.
2. Fix any issues found and rerun syntax and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input, player movement, weapons, vehicle interaction, and bot AI.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup, control layout/styles, and desktop help text.

## Important Context
- The user reported: “Я на телефоне немогу двигаться это же игра будить на телефоне убери wsda я буду именно на телефоне как в играх джостик или стрелки куда ты удерживает и твой персанаж ходит и тагже со стрельбой и перезарядкой”
- Earlier emulated-phone tests verified simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE, reload completion, and player tank entry, driving, and exit; the latest changes have not yet been browser-tested.
- Changes in `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Make the game reliably playable on phones with clear touch movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and allied tank transport behavior.

## Requirements
- Phone movement should use an on-screen joystick or holdable directional controls; movement continues while held.
- Phone aiming, sustained firing, reloading, and vehicle interaction should work through touch.
- Bots should spread out, engage opponents, board the tank, ride, unload, and re-engage.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.
- The allied tank waits while the player is within 12 units, then proceeds after the player moves away.
- Touch devices should get touch-specific controls and instructions; WASD guidance remains for desktop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile MOVE/AIM controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Added bot targeting, spacing, facing, and allied tank boarding/transport behavior.
- Fixed guarded pointer capture and raised HUD stacking order.
- Added touch-device detection, touch-specific HUD visibility/layout and Russian control labels, and avoided pointer lock on touch devices.
- Updated mobile vehicle instructions to describe joystick driving; localized touch control instructions in help text.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Browser-test touch controls at a mobile-sized viewport, including joystick visibility/movement, aiming, sustained fire, reload, and vehicle interaction.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test the latest mobile control changes in a touch-emulated browser.
2. Fix any issues found and rerun syntax and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input, player movement, weapons, vehicle interaction, and bot AI.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup, control layout/styles, and desktop help text.

## Important Context
- The user reported: “Я на телефоне немогу двигаться это же игра будить на телефоне убери wsda я буду именно на телефоне как в играх джостик или стрелки куда ты удерживает и твой персанаж ходит и тагже со стрельбой и перезарядкой”
- Earlier emulated-phone tests verified simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE, reload completion, and player tank entry, driving, and exit; the latest changes have not yet been browser-tested.
- `/usr/bin/chromium` is available; no Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Python websocket module was found in the initial check.
- Changes in `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Make the game reliably playable on phones with clear touch movement, aiming, firing, reloading, and vehicle controls.
- Improve bot movement and allied tank transport behavior.

## Requirements
- Phone movement should use an on-screen joystick or holdable directional controls; movement continues while held.
- Phone aiming, sustained firing, reloading, and vehicle interaction should work through touch.
- Bots should spread out, engage opponents, board the tank, ride, unload, and re-engage.

## Decisions
- USSR weapon: PPSh-41 with drum magazine; Germany weapon: MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock.
- The allied tank waits while the player is within 12 units, then proceeds after the player moves away.
- Touch devices should get touch-specific controls and instructions; WASD guidance remains for desktop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile MOVE/AIM controls, sustained FIRE, RELOAD, vehicle interaction, and faction-specific weapons.
- Added bot targeting, spacing, facing, and allied tank boarding/transport behavior.
- Fixed guarded pointer capture and raised HUD stacking order.
- Added touch-device detection, touch-specific HUD visibility/layout and Russian control labels, and avoided pointer lock on touch devices.
- Updated mobile vehicle instructions to describe joystick driving; localized touch control instructions in help text.
- Touch-emulated browser test confirmed controls appear, joystick movement advances the objective, holding FIRE reduces ammo, and tank boarding/exit works.
- `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Finish touch-emulated browser testing: verify reload completes, right-stick aiming works, and tank movement is confirmed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rerun `/tmp/opencode/cdp-mobile-test.py` and inspect reload completion; latest test script change to wait 3 seconds has not been run.
2. Verify aiming and tank movement with touch input; fix any issues found.
3. Rerun syntax and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input, player movement, weapons, vehicle interaction, and bot AI.
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup, control layout/styles, and desktop help text.
- `/tmp/opencode/cdp-mobile-test.py`: Touch-emulated browser test using Chromium CDP.

## Important Context
- Changes in `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Latest browser run showed controls visible at 844×390; objective distance changed from 37 m to 36 m while moving; ammo fell from 35 to 33 while firing.
- Reload displayed `RELOADING…`, but ammo was still 32 after the 1.3-second wait; the test was edited to wait 3 seconds but not rerun.
- Tank boarding showed `EXIT TANK`, and exiting restored `ENTER TANK`; tank movement itself was not confirmed.
